description: This file declares the external API functions and structure prototypes for the Slap Owo Loao object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) component. It provides function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the object, serving as an interface for other components to interact with this module.

methods.name: SlapCreateOwoLoao
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Owo Loao object with specified context handlers.

methods.name: SlapOwoLoaoCreate
methods.description: Creates the Owo Loao object instance with given context parameters.

methods.name: SlapOwoLoaoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the Owo Loao object instance.

methods.name: SlapOwoLoaoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls internal objects within the Owo Loao instance.

methods.name: SlapOwoLoaoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Owo Loao object instance.
